verdict.rationale: Asana's own materials describe no-code automations via AI Studio and rule actions, plus pre-built AI agents and custom AI Teammates that work inside workflows with governance controls (scoped permissions, audit trail, cost constraints). Rules can also trigger outside actions automatically, such as creating PagerDuty incidents. missing for 10: detailed docs on triggers and scheduling that confirm unattended background execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI Studio or AI Teammates running autonomously.
